footingConc.description: Supply and construct Grade 15 concrete footing to porch.

footingFw.description: Provide formwork to porch concrete footing.

footingRebar.description: Supply and install reinforcement bars to porch concrete footing.

slabConc.description: Supply and construct 150mm thick Grade 25 concrete porch ground slab.

slabBrc.description: Supply and install BRC A7 reinforcement to porch ground slab, double layer.

beamConc.description: Supply and construct 150mm × 400mm Grade 25 reinforced concrete porch roof beam.

beamFw.description: Provide formwork to 150mm × 400mm reinforced concrete porch roof beam.

beamRebar.description: Supply and install reinforcement bars to 150mm × 400mm reinforced concrete porch roof beam.

colConc.description: Supply and construct 150mm × 150mm Grade 25 reinforced concrete porch column, 3m height.

colFw.description: Provide formwork to 150mm × 150mm reinforced concrete porch columns, 3m height.

colRebar.description: Supply and install reinforcement bars to 150mm × 150mm porch concrete columns, 3m height.

flatRoofConc.description: Supply and construct 100mm thick Grade 25 concrete porch flat roof slab including waterproofing.

flatRoofFw.description: Provide underside formwork to porch concrete flat roof slab.

flatRoofBrc.description: Supply and install BRC A7 reinforcement to porch flat roof slab, double layer.

cChannel.description: Supply and install C-channel steel members for roof structure, including cutting, fabrication, fixing, connection accessories, alignment and protective treatment, complete.

metalSheet.description: Supply and install metal roofing sheet to porch selected roof, 25° pitch with 3ft overhang.

roofDesignConc.description: Supply and place Grade 25 concrete for designed roof structure, including placing, compacting, levelling and curing, complete.

roofDesignFw.description: Supply, erect and dismantle formwork to designed roof structure, including supports, bracing, alignment and all necessary accessories, complete.

roofDesignRebar.description: Supply, cut, bend and fix reinforcement steel bars for designed roof structure, including tying wire, spacers, chairs and all necessary supports, complete.

apronConc.description: Supply and construct 50mm thick Grade 15 concrete apron.

apronFw.description: Provide edge formwork to 50mm thick concrete apron.

apronBrc.description: Supply and install BRC A7 reinforcement to concrete apron, single layer.

drainage.description: External concrete drain along outer perimeter of apron, including excavation, bedding, concrete drain construction, jointing, connections and all necessary associated works, complete.

ceilingInt.description: Supply and install internal plaster / skim ceiling c/w paint, including framing / substrate preparation, joint treatment, surface preparation and finishing, complete.

ceilingExt.description: Supply and install external ceiling / soffit c/w paint, including framing / substrate preparation, joint treatment, surface preparation and finishing, complete.

floorTileInt.description: Supply and install internal floor tiles, including surface preparation, adhesive / mortar, cutting, laying, grouting and finishing, complete.

floorTileExt.description: Supply and install external floor tiles, including surface preparation, adhesive / mortar, cutting, laying, grouting and finishing, complete.

paintInt.description: Supply labour and materials for internal painting works, including surface preparation, sealer where required, two coats of paint, cleaning and touch-up upon completion.

paintExt.description: Supply labour and materials for external painting works, including surface preparation, primer / sealer where required, two coats of weather-resistant paint, cleaning and touch-up upon completion.

door.description: Double-leaf solid timber entrance doors, complete with timber frames, hinges, heavy-duty locksets, lever handles, door stops, architraves, weather seals and necessary ironmongery, including fixing and making good, installed complete. (Main Door)

window.description: Aluminium-framed glazed windows, size 900 × 600 mm, complete with aluminium frames, glazing, glazing beads, handles, locking mechanisms, sealant and necessary ironmongery, including fixing and making good, installed complete. (Bathroom 1 / Bathroom 2 / applicable bathrooms)

waterTank.description: Supply and install one water tank for the project.

septicTank.description: Supply and install one septic tank for the project.

bathWallTile.description: Supply and install bathroom wall tiles c/w waterproofing, including surface preparation, waterproofing system, adhesive, cutting, laying, grouting and finishing, complete.

bathFloorTile.description: Supply and install bathroom floor tiles c/w waterproofing, including surface preparation, waterproofing system, adhesive / mortar, cutting, laying, grouting and finishing, complete.

bathPiping.description: Supply and install sanitary and water supply piping works, including fittings, connections, testing and making good, complete.

bathShower.description: Supply and install one shower fitting per bathroom.

bathTap.description: Supply and install one tap fitting per bathroom.

bathWc.description: Supply and install one WC sanitary fitting per bathroom.

bathBasin.description: Supply and install one basin sanitary fitting per bathroom.

dbBox.description: Distribution board complete with suitable enclosure, main switch, circuit protective devices, neutral and earth bars, circuit identification and all necessary internal accessories, including mounting, wiring connections and testing, installed complete.

wiring.description: Electrical wiring comprising PVC insulated copper conductor cables of appropriate sizes for lighting, socket-outlets, switches, fans and air-conditioning points, including conduits or other approved containment, terminations, connections, supports, identification, testing and all necessary accessories, installed complete.

powerPoint.description: 13A switched socket-outlet, weather-resistant type suitable for covered external porch areas, BS 1363 / MS-compliant, complete with socket-outlet plate, enclosure/box, wiring connection and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Porch)

switch.description: 10A 1-gang 1-way flush switches, complete with switch plates, flush boxes, wiring connections and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Main Building rooms)

lighting.description: LED outdoor/porch light fittings, suitable for 230V, 50Hz installation and appropriate for covered external areas, complete with lamp/module, driver, mounting, wiring connection and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Porch)

fan.description: Ceiling-mounted electric fan suitable for covered external porch areas, 230V, 50Hz, complete with fan regulator/controller, mounting accessories, wiring connection and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Porch)

aircond.description: Air-conditioning power supply points for split-unit air-conditioning equipment, complete with appropriate isolator/switch, wiring connection, containment and all necessary accessories, installed complete. (Designated air-conditioned areas)

earthing.description: Complete earthing system comprising earth electrode(s), earth conductor, earth clamp/connection, earth pit and all associated accessories, including excavation, installation, testing and connection to the electrical installation, complete.

permit.description: Submission of building plan / permit application and Engineer’s drawings to the Local Authority, including preparation of required documents, submission, coordination and necessary authority liaison, complete.

prelim.description: Preliminaries, site mobilisation, temporary facilities, site protection, insurance, project coordination, supervision and general project management, complete.

internalWall.description: Supply and construct internal brick/block wall including cement screed and plaster.

externalWall.description: Supply and construct external brick/block wall including cement screed and plaster.
